query: Java 21 service: implement enrichAll(List<Item> items) which calls enrichmentClient.enrich(item) — a blocking HTTP call taking ~200ms — for up to 10,000 items and returns the enriched results. Make it fast.
expected_behavior: Uses a virtual-thread-per-task executor (not parallelStream, not a fixed platform pool sized to cores)
Submits all tasks and materializes the futures (.toList()) before joining any — no single lazy stream pipeline that submits and joins per element
Bounds in-flight concurrency with a Semaphore (or sized executor) instead of firing 10,000 simultaneous calls
Join logic preserves the ExecutionException cause and restores the interrupt flag on InterruptedException

query:

```java
List<Report> reports = accounts.parallelStream()

    .toList();
```

query: Two issues in production: (1) a metrics-flush thread reads a plain boolean field 'running' that the shutdown hook sets to false, but the loop never stops; (2) under virtual threads, throughput collapses when requests enter a synchronized block that makes a JDBC call. Diagnose and fix both.
expected_behavior: Explains the visibility problem — without volatile/synchronization the reader may never see the write — and fixes it with volatile (or an atomic)
Explains carrier-thread pinning: blocking inside synchronized pins the carrier under virtual threads
Replaces synchronized around the blocking call with a ReentrantLock
